result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but the bottom navigation bar is visually broken: the system home indicator bar overlaps the nav icons (search and bookmark), and the nav items lack labels/active-state clarity. Additionally, the third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel and the second 'Popular right now' card are cut off at the viewport edges, which is expected scroll behavior and not counted as a defect.

issues.description: The iOS home indicator (horizontal black bar) is rendered on top of the bottom navigation bar, overlapping and obscuring the search and bookmark/order icons, making the tab bar look broken and potentially hindering taps.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area bottom padding (e.g., padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) to the tab bar so icons sit above the home indicator, or give the tab bar a solid background with sufficient height so the indicator does not overlap interactive elements.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons (home, search, orders, profile) have no text labels and no visible active-state indicator beyond color, which can make their purpose ambiguous, especially for the overlapped search and bookmark icons.
issues.suggestion: Add small text labels under each icon and a clear selected-state treatment (e.g., filled icon plus label tint) to improve recognizability and accessibility.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) button on the dark restaurant cards uses a dark translucent circle that blends into the dark image background, reducing its visibility compared to the same button on lighter images.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent higher-contrast background for the favorite button (e.g., white or a stronger scrim) so it remains clearly visible on all card imagery.
